t: You're in Queen Square, a garden square in Bloomsbury. Many of the buildings around it are associated with medicine, particularly neurology. The square is named for Queen Anne, who ruled from 1702 until her death in 1714, and was the first monarch of Great Britain and Ireland after the Acts of Union. Mary McIntosh, a British sociologist, feminist and campaigner for LGBTQ rights, died here in 2013. She spent her working life studying and challenging how society treats sexuality.
